hook: You can buy a humanoid robot for 2,200 Big Macs

name: patriot
hook: A $4.2 million missile vs a $20,000 drone
post: One Patriot interceptor: about $4.2M, or 680,000 Big Macs. The Shahed drone it's often fired at: 3,000 to 8,000. Cheap machines, expensive answers. #robots #ai #humanoid #tesla #military #ukraine #drones #tech #bigmac #thecurve

name: ukraine
hook: Ukraine ordered 50,000 ground robots this year
post: By September they'd made about 112,000 supply and evacuation runs. Each one, a trip a soldier didn't have to make. #robots #ai #humanoid #tesla #military #ukraine #drones #tech #bigmac #thecurve
